title: Foreign Example PLC files Form F-3/A amendment
bodyText:
FORM F-3/A
REGISTRATION STATEMENT
Foreign Example PLC | (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)

Registration No. 333-123456
Amendment No. 1

EXPLANATORY NOTE

This Pre-effective Amendment No. 1 to the Registration Statement on Form F-3 is being filed solely for the purpose of filing Exhibit 23.1. No other changes have been made to the Registration Statement. The remainder of the Registration Statement is unchanged and has not been included in this filing.

PART II

SIGNATURES

Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Act, the registrant has duly caused this amendment to be signed.
